name: Tube Light Tab Bar
description: Compact dark icon tab bar with a glowing tube light bar that slides over the active tab and casts a soft light cone, while icons light up in sequence.
contents: Five icon tabs (home, bookmark, plus, user, settings) as SVG paths
Sliding light bar with a light cone
behavior: Clicking a tab slides the light bar to it
Icons between old and new tab light up in sequence
Calls onTabChange with the new index
editableByProps: Icons, bar and light colors, unlit opacity, slide speed, initial tab, change callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of tabs beyond five
needsCodeEdit.where: grid-cols-5 class on the nav element

needsCodeEdit.change: Place the light bar at the bottom
needsCodeEdit.where: the light bar div with ref lightRef

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Bar is 350px wide (shrinks on narrow screens) with five columns
